exposure: S. Rao Spiral Suturing (SRSS) of a lower uterine segment
Placenta Accreta, Placenta Increta, Placenta Percreta
cohort: 130 patients with major degree placenta previa/placenta accrete spectrum at the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology Unit-II of Nishtar Medical University, Multan between December 2018 to January 2021
finding: S. Rao Spiral Suturing (SRSS) was a safe and effective technique for managing Placenta Previa and Accreta Spectrum, with low rates of obstetrical hysterectomies, blood loss, and other complications.
